correctness.rationale: Exact finite two-count generator, first/second moment balances and resulting uniform O(n) stationary total-size second moment; the imbalance has o(n) second moment. Stationary accelerated generators converge on compact test functions to (1+cw-w²/2)f’+wf’’. Zero-flux and entrance-boundary constraints uniquely yield the half-Gaussian tilt; uniform integrability yields means. Symbolic and sparse finite-state checker passed 59 assertions for c=-1,0,1 and n=6,12,24,48. Numerical checks are not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The balanced graph gives a two-dimensional nonreversible contact process, so there is no elementary finite birth-death stationary formula. Its single pinned source sustains a nontrivial O(sqrt n) stationary population across a critical window, with an explicit full limiting density, synchronized populations and response-curve mean. This is a motivated finite-size critical phenomenon, qualitatively distinct from previously treated star/fixed-hub processes.
